meta.title: Extend an upcoming RFQ: the end moves, the start does not

plan.title: Extend Upcoming RFQ by One Hour

steps.note: Open the prepared upcoming RFQ on its project summary page.
Capture the current start-time display before changing the submission window.
Extend the upcoming RFQ submission time by one hour; this checks that the end becomes the prior end plus one hour.
Verify that the RFQ start time is unchanged after the extension.
